components.name: Avatar Group
components.description: Overlapping stack of user avatars (image or initials) with an optional +N counter. One row per person.

components.name: Bento Grid
components.description: Asymmetric grid of feature tiles (normal, wide, tall or large) with icon, title, description, optional background image and a call-to-action that slides in on hover. Good for home pages and app launchpads.

components.name: Circular Progress
components.description: Animated ring gauge showing a value against a maximum, with the value in the center. One gauge (partial) or a row of labelled gauges (report).

components.name: Design Alert
components.description: Family of 10 alert and callout designs (soft, side icon, solid, gradient banner, toast card, announcement, tip, quote, inline, panel) with success, warning, danger, info and neutral states. Follows the inline alert pattern of Universal Theme and modern design systems: the state is shown by semantic color plus an icon and a text label, never by color alone. Renders one alert (partial) or a stack of alerts from a query (report).

components.name: Design Avatar
components.description: Person avatars in 8 designs (ring, status dot, squircle, gradient ring, soft initials, with name, count badge, square tile), following the presence and identity patterns of Universal Theme Avatar, Slack and Microsoft Teams. One avatar (partial) or a wrapping row, list or tile grid of people (report).

components.name: Design Badge
components.description: Status badges in 12 designs (soft, solid, outline, dot, live, gradient pill, counter, icon tag, chip, ribbon, code, status bar), following the lozenge and chip patterns of Universal Theme Badge, GitHub labels and shields-style split tags. One badge (partial) or an inline wrapping group (report).

components.name: Design Button
components.description: Link and action buttons in 12 designs (soft, gradient, glass, outline draw, pill arrow, icon circle, 3D press, shimmer, underline, ghost glow, split icon, neon border). Follows the call-to-action patterns of current design systems, built only from the theme palette so each design stays native to Universal Theme. Report mode renders a wrapping action bar.

components.name: Design Card
components.description: Design Collection card family: one record (order, project, invoice, customer) as a card in 12 distinct styles, from a quiet elevated or outlined card to image, horizontal media, ticket, stacked-paper and corner-icon layouts. Follows the Universal Theme Cards pattern (eyebrow, title, body, footer with figure and action) and takes every color from the active theme style.

components.name: Design Divider
components.description: Design Collection divider family: a section break or section heading in 8 distinct styles, from a hairline with a centered title to an eyebrow heading, a glowing gradient rule, an icon medallion, a pill label, an accent underline, a dotted scene break and a side label with a count. Follows the Universal Theme heading and separator pattern and takes every color from the active theme style.

components.name: Design Header
components.description: Family of 10 compact page hero and section header designs (gradient hero, split, minimal, image overlay, dotted grid, card header, centered icon, wave bottom, glass panel, eyebrow) with eyebrow, title, subtitle, icon, optional image and up to two native Universal Theme buttons. Follows the page-header pattern of modern design systems (Oracle Redwood page header, Tailwind UI and Stripe heroes) kept compact for application pages: no full-viewport height, theme colors only, readable in light and dark styles.

components.name: Design KPI
components.description: Design Collection family of ten KPI tile designs chosen with Style: big number, delta chip, glass, gradient, compare, target bar, ring, spark bars, icon left and minimal. Follows the dashboard metric patterns of modern design systems (hero figure first, trend as colored text plus arrow, target as a native progress bar) while every color comes from the Universal Theme palette. One tile (partial) or a responsive grid of tiles (report).

components.name: Design List
components.description: Design Collection family of eleven data-driven lists (avatar rows, files, checklist, leaderboard, contacts, settings, notifications, inbox, metric rows, compact, pills). Follows the native Universal Theme Content Row and Media List pattern: one query row per list row, with avatar or icon, title, subtitle, meta text and an optional link.

components.name: Design Pricing
components.description: Pricing plan cards in 10 designs (classic, highlighted, glass, gradient header, minimal, horizontal, checklist, compact, dark enterprise, outline bold). Follows the common SaaS pricing-table pattern: plan, price with currency and period, short pitch, feature checklist and one call to action, with one plan highlighted.

components.name: Design Profile
components.description: Design Collection family of ten person/profile designs chosen with Style: centered, cover, horizontal, glass, minimal, stats, gradient ring, business card, chip and compact row. Follows the people-card patterns of modern design systems (avatar with presence, name as heading, role, optional stats and a single whole-card link) while every color comes from the Universal Theme palette. One profile (partial) or a responsive grid, wrap or list of profiles (report).

components.name: Design Timeline
components.description: Design Collection family of ten chronological timelines (dots, icon rail, alternating, cards, log, milestones, changelog, numbered, date blocks, branch). Follows the native Universal Theme Timeline pattern: one query row per event, state shown on the marker and as text.

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Centered illustration-style message with icon, title, text and an optional Universal Theme button. Use for no-data, first-run and error placeholders.

components.name: Key-Value List
components.description: Semantic description list (<dl>) for record details: label and value pairs in stacked, side-by-side or grid layout.

components.name: Motion Celebrate
components.description: Full-screen celebration fired on page load or from a Dynamic Action: confetti cannons, a confetti rain or fireworks, optionally with the native APEX success message.

components.name: Motion Count Up
components.description: KPI numbers that count up from zero when they scroll into view, formatted in the user's locale. One figure (partial) or a responsive row of figures (report).

components.name: Motion Effect
components.description: 31 decorative animations from the Motion Gallery: physics, shape morphing, SVG paths, 3D transforms and canvas particle effects such as confetti, fireworks and a spiral galaxy.

components.name: Motion Interaction
components.description: Interactive micro-animations from the Motion Gallery: ripple, magnetic and squish buttons built on native Universal Theme buttons, a 3D tilt card, a cursor spotlight panel and a like toggle.

components.name: Motion Loader
components.description: Seven animated loading indicators from the Motion Gallery: ring, dots, equalizer bars, orbiting moons, counter-rotating arcs, grid wave and indeterminate bar. Announced to screen readers as a status.

components.name: Motion Spotlight Cards
components.description: Card grid where one light follows the pointer across all cards: the nearest borders glow and the card under the pointer lights up softly. Each card has icon, title, text, badge and an optional link.

components.name: Motion Stagger List
components.description: Report rows that animate in one after another the first time the list scrolls into view: rise, slide, scale or blur. Each row has icon, title, description, meta text and an optional link.

components.name: Motion Text
components.description: Animated headline text from the Motion Gallery: wave letters, glitch, masked word reveal, 3D letter flip, typewriter and decode scramble. Text can come from a column or page item.

components.name: Next Alert
components.description: Next Collection family of 10 current-generation alert, toast and announcement designs with success, warning, danger, info and neutral states, in four directions: motion (toast with a travelling border beam, critical banner with a breathing glow ring, announcement ticker that stops on hover, focus and reduced motion), depth (report rows as a 3D toast stack that fans out, floating glass alert with light edge and depth shadow), bold (neo-brutalism, claymorphism, animated hazard stripes) and smart layout (one-line alert that expands with details and summary, adaptive alert that container queries turn into an inline bar, a card or an icon chip). Follows the inline alert and toast patterns of Universal Theme, Sonner and Magic UI: state is always shown by semantic color plus an icon and a text label. CSS only, no JavaScript. The border beam adapts the Magic UI border-beam design.

components.name: Next Approval
components.description: Next Collection approval chain for purchase orders, leave requests and expense claims: one row per approver, with who acts now, the deadline and parallel approvers who share a step number. Follows the approval-routing pattern of ERP and HR systems, but the person who acts now carries an SLA ring around their photo that fills from the moment the request reached them to the due date, so a late approval is visible at a glance. Five styles, each for a named use: Chain (smart, an expense claim in employee self-service; the dates move into their own column when the region is wide), Stepper (motion, the approval strip on a purchase order page; turns vertical when narrow), Signature sheet (bold, the printed sign-off block of a purchase order with rubber stamps), Chip row (depth, a leave request row in a manager's inbox, with overlapping approver discs that open on hover or focus) and Audit log (smart, the decision trail for internal audit written as sentences in time order).

components.name: Next Badge
components.description: Status badges in 10 current-generation designs from the Next Collection: motion (shine glint, live pulse with activity bars, border beam outline), depth (tilted die-cut sticker, extruded 3D pill), bold aesthetics (neo-brutal, clay, holographic foil) and smart shape changes (an icon dot that grows into its label, and a stack that shows a count and fans out into labeled pills). Border beam and shine adapt Magic UI's border-beam and shine-border; every color comes from the Universal Theme palette. One badge (partial) or a wrapping group (report).

components.name: Next Bento
components.description: Next Collection bento family: a report-driven grid of launchpad tiles (title, description, icon, optional figure, link, span) in 10 current-generation styles across the four Next directions: motion (pointer spotlight, travelling border beam), depth (pointer tilt with inner parallax, floating glass over a blurred color field), bold (neo-brutal, clay, one continuous aurora cut into tiles, oversized outline icons on grid patterns) and smart layout (container-query magazine recomposition, tiles that expand while siblings shrink). Follows the Magic UI bento-grid, magic-card, border-beam and grid-pattern patterns, rebuilt as plain CSS on Universal Theme variables so every style follows the active theme style.

components.name: Next Button
components.description: Call-to-action buttons in 12 current-generation designs from the Next Collection, covering motion (border beam, shimmer sweep, rainbow glow, pulse ring), depth (mechanical keycap, layered stack, magnetic float), bold aesthetics (neo-brutal, clay, holographic foil) and smart shape changes (icon that morphs into a label, hold-to-confirm fill). Motion designs adapt Magic UI's shimmer, rainbow, pulsating and border-beam buttons; every color is resolved from the Universal Theme palette so the buttons follow Vita, Vita Dark, Redwood and Theme Roller. Report mode renders a wrapping action bar.

components.name: Next Calendar
components.description: Next Collection family of ten calendars that read events from a report, covering views the native APEX Calendar does not offer. Smart: Month (chips, +N more popover, today ring; turns into a dot calendar with a day agenda when narrow), Agenda (sticky day headers, relative labels, durations) and Timeline Lanes (a resource schedule with one lane per Category and day, week or month zoom). Depth: Week (hour grid, overlapping events side by side, live now line) and Flip Date (a desk tear-off calendar that flips in 3D). Bold: Heatmap (a year of activity by count or Value), Poster Day (a giant date poster for home pages and kiosks) and Circular Year (the year as a ring of month arcs). Motion: Countdown (live tiles to the next events) and Mini Dots (a sidebar mini calendar with a sliding selection and a revealed day). Month and weekday names, numbers and durations come from Intl in the page language, with the Gregorian or Islamic Umm al-Qura calendar, and every view follows the theme's Universal Theme variables, dark styles and RTL.

components.name: Next Card
components.description: Next Collection card family: one record (order, project, invoice, customer) as a current-generation card in 12 styles across four directions. Motion: border beam, pointer spotlight, meteors. Depth: pointer tilt with parallax layers, flip card, fanned layered stack. Bold: neo-brutalism, claymorphism, aurora with film grain, holographic foil. Smart: a compact card that morphs open, and an adaptive card whose composition switches by container width. It keeps the Universal Theme Cards anatomy (eyebrow, title, body, figure, action) so it reads as a native region, and every color comes from the active theme style. Techniques adapted from Magic UI (border-beam, magic-card, meteors), MIT.

components.name: Next Compare
components.description: Next Collection family of five comparison matrices built from one row per option and criterion, for vendor quotations, tender bid evaluation, plans and candidates. The runtime pivots the rows into options by criteria, derives price-type scores from the lowest or highest value (lowest / value x maximum, the usual tender formula), computes weighted totals and ranks, marks the best value in each criterion and the overall leader, lets users hide identical rows and pin an option, and keeps the header row and criterion column sticky. Narrow regions switch to one option at a time with swipe and previous / next buttons. Smart: Tender Table (grouped criteria with weights, standings strip, weighted total and rank rows) and Diff View (every option against a pinned baseline with signed differences, identical rows hidden). Bold: Spec Sheet (heavy datasheet rules, inverted group bands, yes / no as marks with text). Motion: Scorecard (score bars that grow as they scroll in and columns that glide when an option is pinned). Depth: Side Cards (each option as a stack of quotation pages, the leader lifted forward). Pattern follows procurement evaluation sheets used in Gulf government and corporate tenders.

components.name: Next Document
components.description: Next Collection family of five business documents built from line rows: tax invoices, quotations, purchase orders, receipts and payslips. The runtime computes subtotal, discount, VAT per rate (EN 16931 / ZATCA rule: VAT on the taxable total of each rate), total and optional amount in words in English and Arabic, formats money with Intl, and marks the status with a rubber-stamp element. Bold: Classic Invoice (an A4 sheet with ledger rules, a double rule under the total and an inked stamp). Smart: Modern Minimal (meta rail beside the lines when wide, total first when narrow, due date counted in days) and Bilingual Tax Invoice (English and Arabic labels side by side in the ZATCA layout, Hijri date, QR image). Depth: Thermal Receipt (a torn paper strip lifted off the page). Motion: Payslip (earnings and deductions side by side and a pay split bar that settles once). Every style has an A4 print stylesheet (the receipt prints on 80 mm paper). The pattern follows real Gulf tax invoices and payslips rather than a SaaS card.

components.name: Next Gallery
components.description: Next Collection gallery family: a report-driven image gallery (image, thumbnail, title, caption, alt text, link, pixel size, group) in 10 current-generation styles across the four Next directions: smart layout (column masonry with row order, Flickr-style justified rows computed from each aspect ratio, a bento mosaic that promotes wide and tall images, a before and after comparison slider), motion (a filmstrip stage with crossfade, a tight grid whose images zoom and drift under the pointer), depth (a 3D coverflow with reflections, a swipeable card deck) and bold aesthetics (scattered polaroid prints, a lit light table with film sprockets and a loupe). Every style opens the same accessible lightbox: a modal dialog with keyboard, swipe, pinch, wheel and double-click zoom with panning, captions, a counter and a thumbnail rail. Follows the justified-row pattern of Flickr and Google Photos and the lens pattern of Magic UI, rebuilt as plain CSS on Universal Theme variables with one small script.

components.name: Next Hero
components.description: Next Collection family of 10 current-generation page and region heroes for home pages, dashboards and login pages, in four directions: motion (aurora ribbons, meteor shower, grid revealed by a pointer spotlight), depth (retro perspective floor grid, pointer parallax layers), bold (kinetic outline type, neo-brutalism, mesh gradient with film grain) and smart layout (container queries that morph between split, centered and compact bar compositions; words revealed by scroll-driven animation). Follows the landing-page hero patterns of Magic UI and 21st.dev (announcement pill, oversized balanced headline with a highlighted phrase, two actions) rebuilt on Universal Theme variables: every color derives from the theme palette, so Vita, Vita Dark, Redwood and Theme Roller styles are followed. Complete at rest, and every animation stops under reduced motion. Aurora, meteors and retro grid adapt Magic UI designs.

components.name: Next Kanban
components.description: Next Collection board that groups report rows into columns by Column Key, with counts, work-in-progress limits and moving cards by drag and drop or keyboard. Follows the column-board pattern of task tools, but the column header carries the load: every limit slot is drawn, so a full or overloaded column is visible before any card is read. Five styles, each for a named use: Calm lanes (smart, a procurement requisition pipeline; lanes stack when the region is narrow), Ops board (bold, a facilities work-order wallboard with large counts and priority codes), Sticky wall (depth, a campaign planning workshop of paper notes that lift when moved), Due timeline (motion, contract and licence renewals grouped by due date inside each column) and Compact list (smart, a field supervisor's phone view with one column per tab; drop a card on a tab to move it). The board never writes to the database: a move fires the amc:kanban-move event and can set page items for a Dynamic Action to save it.

components.name: Next KPI
components.description: Next Collection family of ten current-generation KPI tiles chosen with Style, covering four directions. Motion: Ticker (odometer digit wheels that spin when scrolled into view), Beam (travelling border beam over a dot grid) and Liquid Fill (tile fills with a moving wave up to Percent). Depth: Tilt (pointer tilt with a floating number plate) and Flip Detail (front figure, back comparison and breakdown). Bold: Neo Brutal, Clay and Aurora Glow. Smart: Bento Tile (container queries recompose number, sparkline, change and ring into bento sub-tiles) and Adaptive (switches between chip, big-number and row layouts by its own width). Effects follow Magic UI patterns (number-ticker, border-beam, magic-card) rebuilt on Universal Theme variables, so every tile follows Vita, Vita Dark, Redwood and Theme Roller changes.

components.name: Next List
components.description: Next Collection family of ten current-generation lists: animated notification feed, logo marquee, pointer spotlight rows, 3D perspective stack, lifting slabs, neo-brutal, clay, terminal log, accordion rows and scroll-reveal rows. Follows the native Universal Theme Content Row pattern: one query row per list row with a lead avatar or icon, title, subtitle, meta text, state and an optional link. Animated feed and marquee are adapted from Magic UI animated-list and marquee, MIT.

components.name: Next Org Chart
components.description: Next Collection org chart that builds a reporting hierarchy from report rows (ID and PARENT_ID, in any order) in five layouts, each made for one job. Top-down (depth) is the classic chart for leadership pages: people sit on name plates, a collapsed team becomes a stack of plates whose thickness shows its size, and teams of individual contributors stack vertically to save width. Left to right (smart) suits deep chains such as a directorate structure and turns into an indented outline in narrow regions. Department swimlanes (bold) give each department a lane with its headcount and open seats, for restructuring and workforce planning. Radial (motion) puts a small project team around its lead, and branches grow out of their manager when opened. Staff directory (smart) is a searchable list grouped under managers that filters as you type and shows each person's chain of command. All layouts share collapsible branches, search that reveals and scrolls to a person, keyboard tree navigation, zoom and drag to pan for large charts, and a hatched empty plate for vacant positions. Without JavaScript the rows show as an outline list indented by Level.

components.name: Next Pricing
components.description: Next Collection family of ten current-generation pricing plan designs chosen with Style, covering four directions. Motion: Beam Featured (the highlighted plan carries a travelling border beam and a glow) and Spotlight (one pointer spotlight lights the borders of every plan card). Depth: Tilt 3D (plans tilt toward the pointer with the price on a floating layer) and Flip Annual (the price slab flips from monthly to annual price and savings). Bold: Neo Brutal, Clay, Holo Premium (holographic foil premium tier) and Aurora Dark. Smart: Expand Features (compact plans that open the full feature list on hover or focus) and Comparison Adaptive (cards when the region is wide, aligned comparison rows when it is narrow). Effects follow Magic UI patterns (border-beam, magic-card, shine-border) rebuilt on Universal Theme variables.

components.name: Next Profile
components.description: Next Collection profile family: one person (employee, customer contact, speaker) in 10 current-generation styles across four directions. Motion: an orbiting light ring around the avatar and a card frame with travelling beams. Depth: a tilting holographic staff ID, a flip card with contact details on the back, and a swaying lanyard badge. Bold: neo-brutalism, claymorphism and a die-cut sticker. Smart: a bento profile that recomposes its tiles by width and a compact row that expands into a full bio. It keeps the anatomy of the Universal Theme profile patterns (avatar, name, role, presence, figures, action) and every color comes from the active theme style. Beam and ring techniques adapted from Magic UI (border-beam, orbiting-circles), MIT.

components.name: Next Thread
components.description: Next Collection comment and activity thread for a record such as a ticket, a purchase request or a case, in five layouts. Chat (motion) shows the conversation as bubbles, yours on the other side, and slides new messages in after a refresh. Audit timeline (bold) sets status changes in large type on a rail with the time beside each step, for approvals and audits. Email (smart) folds earlier messages to one line with the sender and the first words, and opens the latest, for formal correspondence. Activity feed (smart) is a compact log of who did what for a record's side panel, and moves the time into its own column when there is room. Case file (depth) layers entries as sheets in a folder, pins internal notes on top as slips and stamps status changes, for legal, HR and compliance cases. All layouts group entries by day with Intl day names and relative times, nest replies one level, fold long threads behind Show earlier updates, highlight mentions, and mark internal notes with a dashed edge and a label. There is no composer: add a native form and refresh the region after posting.

components.name: Next Timeline
components.description: Next Collection family of ten current-generation timelines: beam rail, pulsing current step, perspective road, 3D card cascade, neo-brutal, clay, kinetic years, metro line, scroll progress and expanding steps. Follows the native Universal Theme Timeline pattern: one query row per event, state shown on the marker and as text, with a current value for progress-style journeys. The beam rail light pulse and border beam are adapted from Magic UI animated-beam and border-beam, MIT.

components.name: Progress Meter
components.description: Accessible horizontal progress bar built on the native <progress> element. Use as a report column (partial) or as a list of labelled bars (report).

components.name: Progress Steps
components.description: Data-driven stepper that shows where a record is in a process (for example an approval or order workflow). One row per step.

components.name: Star Rating
components.description: Page item for 1..N ratings built from native radio buttons: keyboard accessible, works with Dynamic Actions, validations, read-only and session state like any native item.

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: KPI tile with label, value, optional unit, trend delta and icon. Renders one card (partial) or a responsive grid of cards (report).
